Commentary.Commentary: For the Lankans, Nuwan Pradeep bowled a good spell and picked up 2 wickets. The fast bowlers in general did a good job but the slower bowlers disappointed a little. A wicket or two in the middle overs would have really helped. The Proteas will be happier of the two sides as the wicket is a bit sticky. Can the Lankans chase this score down and spring a surprise or will this total prove to be too much? Join us for the chase in a while to find out.

So, after a steady start South Africa will be unhappy to end up with 299. But still, a total around 300 is not bad on a wicket which is not that easy to bat on. The Sri Lankan bowlers bowled tight lines and lengths and did not give a lot away in the first 10. The partnership between Hashim Amla and Faf du Plessis looked like taking the game away from the Lankans. Amla scored a brilliant ton and du Plessis contributed with an attacking 75 of just 70 balls. The Islanders pulled things back with timely wickets towards the latter half but a small cameo from JP Duminy in the end helped them reach 299.

SIX! Oh, yes he can.. Yes, he can! Absolutely magnificent shot from JP Duminy. It's a full toss on off, he moves across a shade and slogs it right off the meat. Clears the wide long on boundary and sends it sailing into the stands for a maximum. With that, SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 299/6!

FOUR! A very welcome boundary for JP Duminy. He's been trying to put 'em away but has missed the last few. He drives this straight back down the ground and beats the two men out in the deep for a boundary. Can he finish the innings with a bang?
Another yorker, Parnell jams it out in front of mid off and scurries across.
Similar ball, but a better result this time. Parnell reaches to it only to miss.
Yorker well outside off, JP can only squeeze it out to point for a single.
Full and wide, outside off, Duminy yet again kneels across to sweep but misses as the ball goes under his bat.

Not out! Back of a length on the stumps, Wayne skips down the track and swings hard. The ball takes a big top edge which goes over short third man. Lakmal is the man there and he chases it down. Turns quickly and hurls a flat, accurate throw at Dickwella who whips the the bails off. It goes upstairs and replays show the batsman is safe. Two runs completed.
A run out appeal against Wayne Parnell is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Misjudges the slower one once again as Parnell throws his bat at it. Somehow manages to clear backward point after coming down the track. Gets two runs for doing so.
Takes the pace off it once more, Parnell is cramped for room as he pushes it to the left of the bowler.
Another slower one, on a length and around off, Parnell looks to play at it but misses.

Deceives the batsman with a slower one, on a back of a length as Parnell attempts to play across the line. It goes under his bat and to the keeper, who scores a direct hit at the striker's end. But Wayne is well inside his crease.
Fuller from Malinga, Parnell makes room for himself and drives it to the right of the mid off fielder. Runs hard and as a result, comes back for the second.

FOUR! Too, too full from Pradeep and he's paid the price. It's wide outside off and Duminy drives this square through point. The fielder there tries to stop it with a dive but he goes over it and concedes a boundary.
Wayne Parnell strides out to bat next.

OUT! Excellent piece of fielding from the Lankan skipper. Full outside off, Morris drills it straight to Tharanga at extra cover and takes him on. The Sri Lankan captain has just one stump to aim but he doesn't miss out. Hits his target and dismisses Morris who had given up. Timely strike for the Islanders, that's a good wicket to take in the fag end of the game.
Low full toss wide outside off, the left-hander reaches out to it and drills it to sweeper cover. One run added to the total.
Almost a yorker well outside off, squeezed out a bit square through cover-point for one.
Pradeep goes full again, JP drives it towards wide mid on and rushes to the other end to get off strike.
Full ball outside off, Chris kneels to drill it through the covers but doesn't exactly middle it. Plays it in the same area and gets a single.
Nuwan Pradeep will bowl once more.

FOUR! Beautiful batting from JP Duminy. Knowing Malinga will go full again, he kneels forward and across to take it on the full. Scoops it fine down the leg side and sends it across the boundary line.
On the fuller side of things, Morris drives it down to long on for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, Duminy jams it out to the mid-wicket area for one run.

That's a missed chance! A virtually dropped catch in all essence. This is quite poor from Malinga, wasn't that difficult to take. It's a length ball on middle and off, Morris goes for the big heave across the line but ends up getting it off the leading edge back to the bowler. Malinga though gets scared as the ball is coming to him and awkwardly tries to catch. It goes past his palms and down to long off for a single.
WIDE! High full toss down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
Yorker on middle and off, JP goes deep inside his crease and flicks it to mid-wicket for a quick run.
The batsman makes room and drives it through extra cover. Long off runs to his left and cuts it off as the batsmen take one.
WIDE! Full delivery angling down leg, Morris flicks and misses.
Arrowed full and wide outside off, like the 4th ball of this over Duminy misses the sweep.
WIDE! Oh, but that's real close. The field is packed on the off side and as a result Duminy shuffles across. Lakmal however aims to hit the leg stump but just misses. Nobody really expected that.
Duminy premeditates the sweep shot and seeing this, Lakmal fires it wide outside off. It goes under the bat and through to the keeper. Intelligent bowling, this.
Brilliant. Morris though will feel he's missed out. It's full and darted on leg, goes off Morris' pads who attempts to flick it across. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls away on the on side.
Full toss speared in on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Extremely full once again, shaping away from the left-hander, squeezed out to point for a single.
A deep fly slip is in place.
FOUR! Yorker outside off, Duminy looks to drill it through the covers but ends up getting an edge. It rushed through the vacant slip cordon and rockets away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Low full toss outside off, pushed square on the off side to retain strike.
FOUR! Very, very full and fired outside off, Duminy opens the face of the bat at the last second and runs it down to the third man fence. Knew exactly what he was doing there, intelligently done.
Just back of a length and just around off, Morris opens the bat face and taps it square on the off side for a brisk single.
FOUR! Nobody can save that one. Morris this time creams the drive perfectly in the gap through the covers. The fielder tries chasing it down but fails in his attempt to do so.
Almost another dipping full toss, it's quite full outside off as Morris drives it to wide mid off. The fielder there makes a good diving effort to save a boundary. Good fielding.
Low dipping full toss outside off, Duminy reaches out to it and drives it through to deep cover for a run.
Lasith Malinga returns to the attack.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Morris stands tall and pulls it away. Rides the bounce well and sends it across the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Pitches this on a length, on middle and leg, Duminy works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Just short of a good length, it straightens up off the deck fractionally as Morris plays it off the outer half past point. Gets a run for that.
Banged in short, sharp bumper which Morris ducks under and evades.
Quite close to the off stick, just back of a length, Morris covers the line and defends it out on the off side.

FOUR! Poor ball, Lakmal will be disappointed but Morris won't mind. It's short and wide, Chris slaps it behind point and beats the third man fielder trying to cut it off. Good shot. He doesn't like to waste any time, wants to be amongst the runs instantly.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to mid off for a quick single.
Slower on the stumps, Morris goes back to punch but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Spills it down the leg side, wide called by the umpire. Was a loud appeal for the keeper but the umpire didn't even bother himself with that.
Fuller on middle, played back in the direction of the bowler.
Chris Morris is the next batsman in.

OUT! Amla is run out! This is some excellent fielding from Kusal Mendis. Hashim Amla's superb knock has come to an end. Well played, my man! It's worked to the mid-wicket region and Amla comes back for the second. Mendis fires a good, accurate throw at Dickwella who whips the bails off in a flash. Hashim dives to get back in but it's not enough. Umpire Dar doesn't even need to refer it upstairs. He raises his finger and that's that.
Outside off, pushed to covers for one.
Darted on a fullish length outside off, Duminy gets across and paddles it fine down the leg side for a double.
Bit ahead of a length on the stumps, Amla pushes it to mid on and Duminy sets off for the run. Backtracks instantly and gets back in time as there is a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Short of a good length, outside off, Hashim Amla punches it through backward point for a couple of runs.
JP Duminy is the next batsman in.

OUT! Lakmal strikes! This is good bowling from Suranga Lakmal. Seeing David Miller give the charge, the Lankan pacer bangs it short and follows him too. The southpaw looks to pull but is cramped for room and as a result, gets a big top edge to third man. Seekkuge Prasanna positioned there settles himself under the ball and takes a good catch. Big wicket for them, Miller as everybody knows is a deadly player, especially at the death.
25th ODI hundred for Hashim Amla! Overall his 5th against Sri Lanka, now back-to-back tons against them.

Hundred from Hashim Amla! The veteran has yet again played a gem of a knock. Stuck in there, took his time and then got going after getting his eye in. Brilliant stuff. Just wrists it in front of square on the leg side and takes a single to bring up the milestone.

Was there an edge? Oh, that was really close. Lakmal hurls an excellent length delivery on the fifth stump line, Amla has a tame poke at it from inside the line and there's a loud appeal for a caught behind as the keeper collects it. Nothing from the umpire. Replays show there was no edge.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Amla shuffles across a bit and works it down in front of mid-wicket. Thinks of the single but then decides against it.
Suranga Lakmal is back on to bowl.
Coming in on off, Miller stands firm and meets it with the full face of the bat. Hashim Amla will be on strike in the next over with just a run shy of a ton.
Moves on to 99 with that. Works it off his pads square on the leg side and gets off strike.

Once again Hashim Amla goes back to flick it to deep backward square leg. Seeing Lasith Malinga is the fielder there, he instantly calls for the second one and some good, hard running gets him that. Alert running, that. Nicely done.
Floats it up on a driving length, Amla isn't tempted as he gets back to keep it out from deep inside his crease on the on side.
Shaping back in around off, Miller kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Comes from around the wicket and drifts it in on off, David Miller pushes it to covers. Doesn't get any run for it as it's straight to the fielder.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Full ball on off stump, Amla drives it down to mid off.
YORKER! Trademark Malinga! Bowls a yorker on middle stump. Amla does well to dig it out.
Short on off stump, Miller guides the ball down to third man for a run.
Full outside off, Miller plays it to the point region.
Strays on the pads, Amla flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Length ball on off, Amla drives it straight to covers.
Lasith Malinga comes back in to the attack.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Full on off, Amla drives it to covers.
Full ball on off, Miller drives it past the diving cover fielder for a run.
Flicks the ball on leg stump for a run to mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, Miller tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Amla tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Asela Gunaratne comes in to the attack.
Full ball, Miller drives it to mid on.
Back of a length ball on off, Miller defends it onto the ground.
Short ball, Amla pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Full ball on the stumps, Amla drives it back to the keeper.
Full and wide outside off, Miller drives it cover-point for a run.
Length ball, angling away. Miller pokes at it and gets beaten.
Malinga has gone off the field.
Miller brings his wrists into play and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven straight back to the bowler.

SIX! BANG! He really plays the spinners so well, doesn't he? Excellent shot. Makes great use of his feet, gets to the pitch and smokes it back over the long off fence for a maximum. Hit it flat and with a lot of power.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Darted full on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Short on the stumps, Amla pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
WIDE! Bowls a bouncer again but this time it bounces over the head of the batsman and the umpire signals wide.
Back of a length ball, Miller defends it off the back foot on the off side for a single.
BOUNCER! Good bowling here from Pradeep. Bowls the bouncer with pace and Miller does well to duck under it.
BEATEN AGAIN! Length ball outside off, Miller tries to drive it on the up but gets beaten and the ball is collected by the keeper.
BEATEN! Length ball, angling away. Miller pokes at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
FOUR! A good way to get off the mark. Quicker and full on the stumps, Miller drives it down the ground for a boundary.
David Miller walks into the middle next.

OUT! BIG BIG WICKET! AB de Villiers is heading back to the hut. Back-to-back wickets for Sri Lanka. Drags the length short, de Villiers goes to pull it but gets a top edge and it lobs to short cover for a very simple catch. Two wickets in quick succession for Sri Lanka.
Tosses it up outside off, the batsman tries to go inside out but gets an edge down to third man for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tosses it up, de Villiers drives it to long off for a run.
BOUNCER! Bouncer on the stumps, Amla ducks under it.
Full outside off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a run.

OUT! Gone they get the breakthrough. It needed something brilliant to get du Plessis out and Chandimal comes up with a piece of brilliance in the field. Short ball, Faf goes for the pull but does not get enough elevation to clear Chandimal at mid-wicket who dives to his right and takes a superb catch. It was a superb innings from Faf. Sri Lanka have got a much-needed breakthrough. Can they build on this wicket?
FOUR! Carved away over backward point! Short of a length ball outside off, Faf just carves it over the man at point for a boundary.
Length outside off, Amla guides it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length ball on off stump, Faf plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
Nuwan Pradeep is brought back on.
Tosses it up on off stump, du Plessis drives it to long off for a run.
Quicker ball, the batsman punches off the back foot through the off side for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsmann.
Full ball outside off, Amla drives it back to the bowler.
Looked to swipe this over long-on but toe ended it to the man at the edge of the ring at mid-wicket. Got too close to the delivery.
Flatter ball on off, Amla pushes it through the off side off the back foot for a run. Five hundred runs between these two in this calendar year.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bowled on middle, Faf goes to flick it but gets a leading edge and the ball rolls on the off side and they run a single.
Bowled on the leg stump, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a run. This is his highest individual score in the Champions Trophy.
FOUR! BRILLIANTLY PLACED! Full on leg stump, Amla lifts it over square leg into gap between fine leg and deep square leg for a boundary.
Full on the pads, Amla flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Length ball on leg stump, Faf flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Short ball outside off, Amla cuts it but can't pick the gap.
Bowled it on the pads, de Plessis flicks it off his pads for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Tosses it up on off stump, Faf drives it beautifully through the covers for a boundary.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Prasanna has been bowling well so far. Can he apply pressure and break this partnership?
Tossed on middle, the batsman drives it back to the bowler.
Drinks are on the field!
Lands it on a length on leg stump, Amla moves inside the line and flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it to square leg.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Slower on middle, Amla tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge and just goes wide of cover fielder for a run.
Length ball on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a couple.
Bowled on the pads, Faf flicks it to square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Amla goes to guide it down to third man but misses it and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball, du Plessis pushes it through the off side off the back foot for a run.
Short again, the batsman pulls it behind square for a couple.
Faf comes down the track to the length ball, the ball skids through and keeps a touch low. du Plessis misses it and it goes through to the keeper.
Short on the body of the batsman, Faf pulls it thorugh mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Amla guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full on leg stump, the batsman drives it down to long on for a run.
Persists with the leg stump line, Amla flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Slower on leg stump, the batsman flicks it on the leg side for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
28th ODI fifty for Faf du Plessis!
Full ball on leg stump, the batsman works it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Faf brings up his fifty with that single. It has been a very good innings.
Short on the body, du Plessis pulls it to square leg for a run.
100-run stand between Amla and du Plessis!

Back of a length ball, Faf pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple. An important 100-run partnership between the two. It is their seventh hundred partnership together. They enjoy batting with each other.
Short ball on the stumps, Amla pulls it uppishly to deep square leg for a run.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Amla tries to guide it down to third man but fails to get bat on it and gets beaten.
Short of a length, Faf pulls it to square leg for a run.
FOUR! SMASHED! Lakmal bowls it a little short. du Plessis rocks back and pulls it to the vacant mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Suranga Lakmal comes back in to the attack.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Plays the ball on leg stump to mid-wicket for a run.
Persists with the leg stump line. du Plessis flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, du Plessis flicks it on the leg side and they run two. Good running there by the batsmen.
Slower on the leg stump, Faf flicks it to mid-wicket.
Bowls it on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Asela Gunaratne will have a change of ends.
On the pads, Amla tucks it behind square on the on side and gets a single to his name.

A great fielding effort there from Chamara Kapugedera. It's very full outside off, du Plessis on the bump drills this square towards point. Chamara there dives full stretch to his right and gets his hand to it. Takes the pace off it as he parries it to the man at deep cover. Single taken.
Easily done. Amla rotates strike with a little dab down to third man.
Skidding off the deck a bit, coming into Faf du Plessis. He somehow manages to work it away square on the leg side off the inner half for a single.
WIDE! Slower full toss going down leg, looks to help it on its way but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Straighter in line, du Plessis wrists this straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis attempts to run it down to third man with a slightly opened face but misses it completely. It goes past the edge and into the keeper's gloves.

SIX! BANG! They just made the change of getting mid-wicket in and Amla targets that area. The bowler tosses it up, Amla comes down the track and hits it over mid-wicket for a maximum, two boundaries in the over. A good one for South Africa.
Bowls it on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side.
Tosses it up, Amla defends it off the back foot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Sweeps the ball from outside off stump to the vacant mid-wicket region for a boundary. These two are ticking along well here.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman drives it to covers.
Short on the body of the batsman who pulls it down towards short fine leg. The fielder dives to his left and makes a good stop, concedes only a single.
Very full outside off, Faf drives it straight to point for no run.
Length outside off, Amla guides it down to third man for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Amla flicks it on the leg side for a couple.
Length ball on the stumps, the batsman defends it by covering the line of the ball.
FOUR! Bowls it on the pads, Amla flicks it down to fine leg and the ball races down to the fence.
Lasith Malinga is brought back into the attack.
34th ODI fifty for Hashim Amla.
Back of a length on off stump, Amla punches to sweeper cover to bring up his fifty. It has been a very patient innings.  He's really picking up the pace now.

FOUR! Short and wide, slapped away to the right of the diving backward point fielder, and sweeper cover was not square enough to cut this off. It was close enough to the backward point fielder to count as a misfield.
Short again, on the stumps this time, pulls it in the air, flies into the vacant deep mid-wicket region. The batsmen run two and that brings up South Africa's 100.
Short ball outside off, Amla cuts it straight to point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Flatter outside off, Amla punches it through the off side for a run.
Full ball, Amla drives it down the ground for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Back of a length, nips in towards off stump. Amla shuffles across to work it through square leg for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Faf flicks it on the leg side for a run. 50-run stand between the two is up.
Bowls it slower on the pads, the batsman flicks it to square leg and puts pressure on him by running the second. Malinga misfields and they complete the second quite easily.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Flatter ball, Amla punches off the back foot through the off side for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! NICELY SWEPT! Bowls it outside off, du Plessis goes down on one knee and sweeps it behind square for a boundary.
Amla drives it to long off for a run.
Floats it outside off, Faf gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Amla drives it down to long off for a run.
Bowls it slower on off, Amla goes for a flick but gets a leading edge and it goes down to mid off for a run.
SIX! BANG! First six of the innings. The bowler bowls it full on off. Amla moves his front leg out of the way and lofts it over mid off for a maximum. Great shot by Amla.
Full ball on middle, du Plessis flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Amla flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, Amla pushes it on the leg side off the back foot.
Short outside off, Amla rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Asela Gunaratne is back on to bowl.
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis goes to drive but gets it off the outer half to point.
Very close to the off pole, easily dealt with by the batsman.
Quite slow through the air, Faf is early into the shot as he looks to drive. Mistimes it to the covers for nothing.
Provides some decent flight on this occasion, drops this around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Quicker through the air outside off, du Plessis hangs inside his crease and drives it through to sweeper cover for two.
Flat, short and outside off, Amla goes back and punches it past point for a single.
FOUR! LOVELY STUFF! Length ball outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a boundary.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, Faf flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length ball on off stump, the batsman pushes it off the back foot.

DROPPED! Oh what have you done, Lasith? Sees him stepping out early and bangs it in short, just outside off. Goes for the pull, only manages a top edge, and Malinga, stepping backwards at the deep square leg boundary, steps on the boundary cushions, and loses a bit of balance while having to move forward again. Dives forward and the ball slips through his fingers. Didn't get his palms under it. That was hit against the wind and that's probably why Malinga ended up misjudging it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Flatter ball, the batsman plays it on the off side for a run.
Defends the ball on the stumps off the front foot.
Lucky there! Flighted ball on the stumps. Amla goes for the drive but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Floats it up on off, Amla drives it to covers.
Tosses it up on the stumps, du Plessis drives it to mid on for a run.
Flicks the ball on leg stump to deep square leg for a run.
Full ball, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Bowls it on the pads, Faf flicks it to fine leg where Malinga is quite slow to the ball and they come back for the second. Good running from du Plessis.
Length ball, the batsman punches it off the back foot.
BOUNCER! Bowled short on the stumps. Faf ducks under it and the umpire signals one for the over.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Drifts on the pads, Faf flicks it on the leg side and the batsmen run two.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka have started off amazingly well with the ball. They've applied pressure on the South African batsmen and removed the dangerous Quinton de Kock. It's a difficult wicket to bat on, with the ball not coming onto the bat properly. It'll be a tough task for du Plessis and Amla to keep the runs going at a decent rate.

Loud shout for LBW. Bowls a googly on leg stump. Amla goes for the flick off the back foot but misses it and is struck on the pads. The Sri Lankans appeal and the umpire gives it not out. It was missing leg stump.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Amla waits for it and opens the face of the bat. Guides it down to the third man and the ball races away to the fence.
Flatter ball, Amla puches it to covers off the back foot.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Drives the ball on off to long off for a single.
Wide! Drifts down the leg side, the batsman goes to flick it but misses it and is called wide.
Bowls it on the pads, Faf attempts a flick but gets struck on the pads and the ball rolls on the leg side.
Seekkuge Prasanna is into the bowling attack.
Length ball outside off, Faf guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Faf lets it go through to the keeper.
Bowls it on a length. du Plessis plays outside the line as this one nips back in a long way to hit him high on his pads. There was a bit of inside edge there too.
Full ball on the stumps, the batsman pushes it straight down the ground.
Faf du Plessis comes out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! That tight line pays off. Sri Lanka get their first breakthrough. Pradeep bowls it on a length, angles it away. De Kock pokes at it and gets an outside edge. Dickwella dives to his left and takes a good catch.
Full ball angling in, de Kock flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, Amla flicks it to square leg for a run.
Bowls it on off, Amla works it on the leg side.
Lands it on a length, the batsman plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
Very full on off, de Kock slices it behind point for a couple.
Bowls it on a length outside off, de Kock goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Asela Gunaratne comes on to bowl.
Length ball on the stumps, de Kock works it on the leg side for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Full ball on the pads, de Kock flicks it through the vacant mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Very full ball, de Kock drives it behind point. The point fielder gets a hand to it and takes the pace off the ball. The batsman run through for a couple.
BOUNCER! Pradeep bowls a well directed bouncer. De Kock does well to evade it.
Full on the stumps, Amla drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball, Amla defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Lakmal drifts on the pads. Amla flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket for a boundary. Only the second boundary of the day.
Drifts on the pads, Amla works it straight to short fine leg. Amla should have done better with that ball.
Lands it on a length on the stumps, Amla works it on the leg side.
Length ball on the stumps, de Kock defends it off the front foot.
Full ball outside off, Amla drives it to the left off point. Kapugedera dives to his left and stops the ball.
Walks down the track, the bowler pulls his length back a little. de Kock pushes the ball on off stump back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it on a length on off, Amla tries to drive it on the up but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to mid on. The batsmen scamper through for a run.
Length ball on the stumps, Amla plays it on the leg side. Sri Lanka are bowling some tight lines here.
Pushes the back of a length ball on off to covers.
Length ball on the stumps, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Nuwan Pradeep is into the attack now.
Full on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for an easy run.
Beautiful. Terrific seam position, it's moving about as Lakmal lands it around off, Amla gets behind the line of the ball and defends solidly.
Quite straight in line, de Kock works it towards short fine leg and crosses over.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed behind point for a single.
Tight line again, he's making Amla really work for everything. It's punched from the crease to mid off.
Excellent delivery from Lakmal! Bowls a great line, in the off stump channel and gets that little bit of away movement. Hashim Amla is just beaten as he has a tame push from inside the line.
Back of a length ball, the batsman plays it to point.

Back of a length ball, Amla pushes it to mid off off the back foot and sets off for a run. The mid off fielder has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end but misses. Amla was safe even if he had hit.
Length ball outside off, de Kock guides it down to third man for a run.
Full ball, de Kock drives it down to mid off.
BEATEN! Brilliant slower one outside off, de Kock goes for the drive but is early into it and gets beaten. The keeper collects the ball on the bounce.
FOUR! Finally South Africa get their first boundary! Slower ball outside off, de Kock leans into the drive and finds the gap between point and covers and it races away to the fence.
Length ball outside off, Amla drives it to covers. The ball is not quite coming onto the bat.
Ahead of a length, de Kock tries to drive it on the up but gets an inside edge to the right of short fine leg. The batsmen run a single.
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off, de Kock slashes at it but misses it and the umpire signals wide.
Full ball outside off, de Kock slashes at it but does not quite hit the middle and hits it straight to covers.
Back of a length ball, Amla flicks it towards wide mid on for a run.
Full ball on middle, Amla drives it wide of mid on. The batsmen run two.
Length ball, Quinton flicks it through the leg side for a run.
On a length once again, outside off, punched straight to the cover fielder off the back foot.
On a good length and slanting across, Quinton de Kock opens the face and comfortably steers it down to third man for a single.
Hurls this on middle and off, it's worked straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Takes some pace off this and bowls it on a length on off, Quinton isn't quite to the pitch of the ball as he pushes it to mid off.
Slightly fuller in length, just outside off, driven to the mid off fielder for nothing.

Fires it extremely full, on middle and off, de Kock pushes it back down the ground. Thinks about taking the run but Amla firmly shouts "no" and sends him back. Good call, both mid off and mid on quickly got to the ball.
Length on his pads, Amla flicks it straight to square leg.
Full ball on off, de Kock drives it to mid off for a quick single.
Bowls it on a length outside off. The batsman again plays down the wrong line. Prods half-heartedly to get a thick inside edge onto the pad and the ball rolls to cover point.
Back of a length ball outside off, de Kock goes for the pull but the ball does not bounce enough and goes under his bat.
Full ball on off, the batsman drives it to mid off.

NOT OUT! Quinton de Kock survives! Lakmal bowls it on a length on the stumps, de Kock tries to defend it off the back foot but misses it and is struck on the pads. Sri Lanka go up for the appeal but is given not out by the umpire. They decide to review it and the umpire goes upstairs. The ball pitches in line, the impact is in line but it's just clipping the off bail, so it remains the umpire's call. Sri Lanka lose their review. It looked mighty close.
Sri Lanka have reviewed for an LBW against de Kock.
Pushes the length ball outside off, straight to covers.
Lands it on a length outside off, de Kock plays it with an angled bat down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on off, Amla guides it to third man off the back foot for a run.
Slower ball outside off, de Kock drives it to the right of mid off and they get through for a run.
Length on middle, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Just ahead of a length, Amla defends it off the front foot. Tight bowling from Sri Lanka.
Fuller length ball on the stumps, de Kock pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length on middle, de Kock defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on middle, de Kock flicks it to square leg.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Length ball on middle, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket and they run three.
Bowls it on a length outside off, gets a little away movement. Amla lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Suranga Lakmal will bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two slips for him as well.
Pitches it full and gets driven to mid off. Three off the first over.
Bowls it full on off stump, de Kock drives it to covers.
WIDE! Strays it down the leg side, de Kock goes for the flick but misses it and is called wide by the umpire.
Full ball on off stump, de Kock drives it to mid off.
Length ball, de Kock defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Bowls it full down the leg side. De Kock attempts to flick it but misses it and the umpire signals wide.
Full on the pads, Amla flicks it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Back of a length ball, Amla defends it on the back foot.

The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock will open the batting for South Africa. Lasith Malinga will open the bowling for Sri Lanka. There are two slips in place.
Both teams have lined up side by side for their respective national anthems and we'll be starting with South Africa's first.

Sri Lanka XI - Upul Tharanga(c), Niroshan Dickwella(wk), Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal, Kusal Perera, Chamara Kapugedera, Asela Gunaratne, Seekkuge Prasanna, Suranga Lakmal, Nuwan Pradeep, Lasith Malinga.
South Africa XI - Quinton de Kock(wk), Hashim Amla, Faf du Plessis, AB de Villiers(c), David Miller, Jean-Paul Duminy, Chris Morris, Wayne Parnell, Kagiso Rabada, Morne Morkel, Imran Tahir.

AB de Villiers says it's the toss is not a problem but they would have bowled first as well. Reckons they come in with a lot of confidence and are prepared. Thinks they started finding their rhythm towards the end of the England series, even if it was a little too late. Feels confident however of things going into the tournament. Mentions Morne Morkel is in the team as everybody knows what he's capable of and David Miller and Imran Tahir are fit again. (On winning the Champions Trophy) Says they haven't done it yet, small steps to the trophy, the first of them being this Sri Lanka game.

Upul Tharanga says they will bowl first. The conditions are overcast and it'll be good to bat on later. Informs Angleo Mathews should be fit soon enough, injury has hampered him playing today. Mentions they have three seamers and Lasith Malinga back in the side, with one leggie in the team. States he's (Malinga) been the best bowler for them in last 10 years, playing international cricket after 18 months so it's nice to have him back. Ends by saying being the underdogs is a good thing for them as it takes pressure off them.
TOSS - SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND WILL FIELD FIRST!

Pitch Report - Nasser Hussain says the fresh pitch might offer a bit more to the seamers than it did a couple of days ago in the Bangladesh game. Shaun Pollock mentions everybody saw Josh Hazlewood yesterday how he bowled. He reckons it comes down to your skill level, if you can get the ball to move you can be successful. The ex-England international let's everybody know how Kagiso Rabada has bowled on a fuller length which has allowed the ball to move a lot and states that is the secret to getting wickets in England. Pollock adds on that by explaining you can't go too full or too short, your variations need to be quite consistent. When asked about Lasith Malinga's effectiveness with the yorker by Nasser, he further adds the margin for error is a lot bigger because of his action, difficult to pick the yorkers properly. His slower ones dip on the batsmen and that makes it difficult to counter them. Nasser Hussain ends the pitch report by saying it's going to be a batsman-friendly tournament, so will be interesting to see how the bowlers fare.

On the other hand, Sri lanka head into the tournament as underdogs. The Islanders will be without their captain Angelo Mathews for the first game. Upul Tharanga will be their stand-in captain for today. They would want to show some character and put up a fight today against the mighty South African side.

Hello and welcome to the first game of group B,  between Sri Lanka and South Africa at The Oval. The Proteas are one of the favorites to win the tournament. They are ranked No.1 in ODIs in the world and they would want to start their campaign off with a win.
